phases.title: Project definition
phases.description: Load declarative product inputs and plan agent-owned production work.

phases.title: Studio control
phases.description: Own Roblox Studio process, session, place and bridge lifecycle.

phases.title: Build
phases.description: Compile a hash-bound place from source through a reproducible build adapter.

phases.title: Edit mode
phases.description: Inspect and intentionally mutate the edit-time DataModel.

phases.title: Runtime
phases.description: Start, observe and stop a real running DataModel.

phases.title: Player actor
phases.description: Exercise navigation and interaction through synthetic and player-equivalent actors.

phases.title: Client
phases.description: Observe client-only UI and logs and invoke supported client interaction seams.

phases.title: Capture
phases.description: Control viewpoints and collect identity-bound visual evidence.

phases.title: Assets
phases.description: Discover, create, validate and integrate production assets with provenance.

phases.title: Publication
phases.description: Publish approved assets and deploy an exact experience build through authenticated Roblox services.

phases.title: Multiplayer
phases.description: Validate simultaneous clients, servers, isolation and replication.

phases.title: Persistence
phases.description: Validate save, rejoin, migration, retry and failure semantics against real services.

phases.title: Monetization
phases.description: Provision products and validate secure purchase and receipt flows.

phases.title: Release
phases.description: Assemble immutable evidence and decide a single fail-closed release candidate.

capabilities.title: Declarative project loading
capabilities.description: Loads project, contract and visual policy through repository-owned validators.
risks: Individually valid inputs can still describe different product identities unless an alignment proof is required.

capabilities.title: Headless fixture adapter
capabilities.description: Inventories the legacy fixture-backed adapter so it cannot be confused with a production measurement surface.
risks: Fixture values can describe intended behavior while the real Workspace is empty or broken.
gaps: A fixture adapter cannot satisfy any production measurement or release requirement.

capabilities.title: Build and runtime product identity binding
capabilities.description: Stamps product intent and artifact hashes into the candidate and measures them back from the exact Studio DataModel before product-truth evaluation.
risks: A caller-supplied expected product must never be echoed as runtime evidence; Studio reads only the build stamp.
gaps: Install/restart the plugin and execute a complete stamped release attempt against a live exact-build Studio session.

capabilities.title: Agent production orchestration
capabilities.description: Provides state-machine, DAG, ownership and impact-selection primitives for agent work.
risks: Primitive correctness does not imply that an external agent runner respects locks or transitions.
gaps: A production runner must bind agent dispatch, retries, budgets and artifacts to the state machine.

capabilities.title: Studio and bridge lifecycle
capabilities.description: Starts, restarts, handshakes with and identifies a Studio session and place.
risks: A killed Studio can leave an apparently live long-poll session until it is explicitly retired.
gaps: Safe concurrent ownership of multiple Studio processes by PID, HWND, place, build and agent is not end-to-end validated.

capabilities.title: Generic Studio MCP gateway adapter
capabilities.description: Inventories the transport-injected Studio game adapter and its generic MCP-style operations.
risks: Unversioned gateway method names can drift independently from the typed Studio Bridge command surface.
gaps: Every MCP operation needs a versioned schema, explicit session/build/player selectors and a verified mapping to the typed bridge.

capabilities.title: Hash-bound Rojo place build
capabilities.description: Builds a place and records input and output provenance for an immutable candidate.
risks: An external Rojo binary or project change during compilation can make a candidate inconclusive.
gaps: A reusable build adapter with tool-version pinning, caching and isolated concurrent workers is missing.

capabilities.title: Edit-time DataModel inspection
capabilities.description: Reads hierarchy, properties and indexed objects from the actual edit-time DataModel.
risks: GetFullName paths are not unique when siblings share names.
limitations: A watch is bounded at 500 changes, so a value that ticks every frame loses its earliest history.

capabilities.title: Edit-time mutation and client bridge installation
capabilities.description: Executes edit-only Luau and installs or removes the typed client bridge.
risks: Arbitrary edit execution can bypass reusable APIs and contaminate source-of-truth state.
gaps: Mutation fencing and idempotency are not enforced inside the plugin executor for every operation.

capabilities.title: Runtime lifecycle and output measurement
capabilities.description: Starts and stops Run mode and samples state and server output from one pinned session.
risks: Run mode does not revert generated instances and a second pass can measure a duplicated world.

capabilities.title: World geometry and navigation measurement
capabilities.description: Measures bounds, support, overlap, pathfinding, raycasts and world summaries in Studio.
risks: A failed navmesh control probe makes a NoPath result inconclusive rather than a level defect.

capabilities.title: Policy-free visual quality snapshot
capabilities.description: Measures classification coverage, oriented bounds, area-weighted surfaces and landmark visibility from playable region samples in Studio.
risks: Self-declared classification can hide untagged geometry unless eligibility is derived independently from the Workspace; ray budgets must fail as truncated rather than silently reducing coverage.
gaps: Install and restart the plugin, then measure a pinned exact-build runtime session to promote this capability beyond static validation.

capabilities.title: Synthetic runtime actor
capabilities.description: Spawns and controls deterministic rigs for navigation, touch and prompt discovery.
risks: A synthetic rig is not a Player and cannot prove client-only or Player-authorized behavior.

capabilities.title: Real-player attachment and interaction
capabilities.description: Attaches the actor to a Play Solo player and drives prompt interaction through the client.
risks: A foreground F5 can land in the wrong application unless HWND focus is proven immediately before input.
gaps: Unattended, multi-player-equivalent client allocation is not available.

capabilities.title: Client DataModel, UI, state, image and log observation
capabilities.description: Reads the selected player's client-side DataModel, UI, state, image loading and output. `client.tree` and `client.properties` mirror the server pair exactly, so the only difference at a call site is which side is being asked -- which is what makes anything built client-side (a viewmodel, a LocalTransparencyModifier, a client-only effect) readable at all.
risks: Server logs cannot reveal a LocalScript failure and image assignment does not prove that moderated content rendered.
A client read answers for one player's machine. Two clients in the same session can disagree, and neither disagrees with the server in a way the server can see.

capabilities.title: Supported client action seams
capabilities.description: Triggers prompts and invokes explicit remotes or bindables exposed for testable client behavior.
risks: Direct remote invocation can become a white-box shortcut if used before a black-box human-mode failure.
gaps: There is no generic player-equivalent pointer or touch UI input adapter.

capabilities.title: Synthetic GUI clicking
capabilities.description: Client input via the public VirtualInput API, with button activation observed separately from delivery.
risks: Pretending a click happened would produce false E2E evidence.
gaps: Complete GUI and touch/gamepad journeys still require runtime and E2E evidence.

capabilities.title: Deterministic camera control
capabilities.description: Sets, focuses and reads camera pose through the pinned Studio session. The camera.* commands run in the plugin, which lives in the edit DataModel; during Play the viewport renders a different camera, so client.camera_set relays to the running client. Without it a capture during play comes back from wherever the player camera happened to be, and reports applied.
risks: A camera command can target a different session if reads are not pinned.

capabilities.title: Identity-bound viewport capture
capabilities.description: Prefers StudioCaptureService for viewport bytes directly from Studio without foreground ownership; preserves session/place/build/spec provenance and keeps Win32 capture only as a labelled compatibility fallback.
risks: Native capture permission or buffer availability can vary by Studio version/context; fallback evidence must declare which backend produced the frame.
The Win32 fallback can capture overlapping desktop content and must never masquerade as native viewport evidence.
gaps: Live-revalidate native StudioCaptureService screenshots on plugin 2.1 while Studio remains in a persistent minimized/background session.
Validate deterministic device-resolution capture matrices with StudioDeviceSimulatorService.

capabilities.title: Hash-bound provider visual review
capabilities.description: Reviews trustworthy captured viewpoints through a strict provider-neutral rubric contract and derives scores outside the model.

adapters.role: provider-neutral lineage, rubric and citation validator
optional OpenAI Responses image and Structured Outputs adapter

risks: A vision model can misjudge severity or visible detail; model findings remain advisory until deterministic evidence corroborates them.
gaps: Run a credentialed, representative and calibrated capture review before raising this capability above STATICALLY_VALIDATED/PARTIAL.

capabilities.title: Asset discovery and previews
capabilities.description: Searches local or Roblox catalogs and returns metadata, provenance and preview records.
risks: Remote metadata can omit licensing facts or change after selection.
gaps: A live, cached, ranked search run with complete licensing receipts is still required.

capabilities.title: Local asset creation and validation
capabilities.description: Creates content-addressed drafts and validates mesh, audio, animation and icon payloads.
risks: Syntactically valid files can still be aesthetically poor, unrigged or too expensive at runtime.
gaps: Professional generation and optimization adapters for every required asset kind are not connected.

capabilities.title: Published asset integration
capabilities.description: Builds deterministic bindings from approved asset identities to declarative game targets.
risks: An approved asset ID can be bound to the wrong semantic target without runtime visual and audio proof.
gaps: Automatic source integration is still missing: an id that resolves is not an id that has been wired into a game, and nothing here does the wiring.
evidence: Verified 188 referenced asset ids against a live Studio through assets.verify: 187 resolve. The one that does not is `rbxassetid://0`, a placeholder in a doc comment. The run also found that the conveyor's tread texture pointed at `textures/SurfacesDefault/metal.png`, a path that does not exist -- the belt had been drawing no texture at all.

capabilities.title: Idempotent Roblox asset publication
capabilities.description: Stages immutable payloads, issues at-most-one upload per package and polls moderation state.
risks: Credentials, creator permissions and moderation are external state and must never be inferred from a staged package.
gaps: A credentialed live upload, moderation and integration cycle has not been validated.

capabilities.title: Experience deployment
capabilities.description: Saves or publishes the intended Roblox place through explicit authenticated/native adapters, with destructive publication kept behind separate confirmation.

adapters.role: authenticated Open Cloud place version and publication adapter

risks: Saving or publishing targets remote Roblox state; place/universe identity and operator intent must be explicit.
Studio native save can be blocked by Team Create, permissions or an unpublished DataModel.
gaps: Execute a credentialed end-to-end place save/publish, verify the resulting Roblox version identity, and prove rollback with immutable receipts.
limitations: studio.save_place is edit-mode only and requires explicit overwrite confirmation; publication requires a second confirmPublish opt-in.

capabilities.title: Live multiplayer scenarios
capabilities.description: Native Studio test and device command surface; concurrent gameplay assertions still require validation.
risks: Single-player success cannot reveal cross-player state leaks, replication races or server authority defects.
gaps: Multi-client and multi-server allocation, synchronization, assertions and teardown are missing.

capabilities.title: Live persistence lifecycle
capabilities.description: Validates save, failure, retry, migration and rejoin against authoritative persistence services.
risks: Fixture-backed state can mask lost writes, duplicate grants, migration failures and rejoin defects.
gaps: DataStore test environments, fault injection, rejoin orchestration and immutable save receipts are missing.

capabilities.title: Secure monetization lifecycle
capabilities.description: Provisions products and validates purchase prompts, receipts, idempotency and grants.
risks: A client-visible price or simulated grant is not proof of a valid Roblox receipt.
gaps: Product provisioning, sandbox purchase, receipt replay and grant reconciliation adapters are missing.

capabilities.title: Immutable fail-closed release candidate
capabilities.description: Builds one candidate, binds evidence to its run and build, and finalizes an immutable decision artifact.
risks: A structurally sound gate remains incomplete when required producers are absent or not integrated.
gaps: Product alignment needs live validation; capture, visual review, asset approval, persistence, multiplayer and monetization must all be integrated before industrial release.

capabilities.title: Author an image in-engine and publish it as a real asset
capabilities.description: Generates a token-derived raster, writes it into an EditableImage inside Studio and publishes it through AssetService:CreateAssetAsync, returning a persistent asset id with content provenance.

adapters.role: human-gate preflight over live Studio capabilities

risks: Publishing is irreversible from this side: the asset exists on Roblox and enters moderation.
Moderation latency is unbounded, so a published id is not an approved id.
limitations: Requires the "CreateAssetAsync Luau API" beta enabled in Studio > File > Beta Features. The method is present on AssetService without it and refuses the call, so its presence cannot be used to detect the gate.
Moderation is asynchronous and outside this pipeline: a published id is not an approved id, and asset 103055152891653 read back as Reviewing immediately after publishing.
Rate limited to 30 uploads per minute.
evidence: Published a 16x16 image from EditableImage through AssetService:CreateAssetAsync and read it back independently through Open Cloud: assetId 103055152891653, assetType Image, creator 5812220258, moderationState Reviewing.

capabilities.title: Typed DataModel mutation primitives
capabilities.description: Create, update, delete, clone and inspect instances through declared, schema-validated commands, so building a world never requires arbitrary Luau execution.
risks: Mutations are at-most-once: a timeout leaves the caller unable to distinguish applied from not applied without re-reading.
gaps: No live Studio run has exercised these commands; they remain STATICALLY_VALIDATED until measured against a real DataModel.

capabilities.title: Runtime telemetry: frame timing, memory, physics, network, logs
capabilities.description: Samples frame and physics timing over a real window and reports distributions rather than instantaneous counters, plus memory by category, replication traffic, and the log split by severity.
risks: Sampling holds a command thread open for the requested window.
gaps: No live sampling run has been measured against a running place.

capabilities.title: Region queries, spawn points, navmesh probe and terrain voxels
capabilities.description: Bounded spatial queries, arrival-point inventory, a navmesh control probe that separates an unreachable destination from broken pathfinding, and voxel terrain read/write.
risks: world.terrain writes are destructive and snap to the 4-stud voxel grid.
gaps: Not yet exercised against a live place.

capabilities.title: Teleport, equip, activate and inventory
capabilities.description: Completes the family that lets an agent play the product rather than only walk through it.
risks: actor.activate fires the game's own handler; twice is two uses, so it is at-most-once.
Teleporting deliberately skips the navigability proof that walking provides.
gaps: Not yet exercised against a live place.

capabilities.title: Headless mesh authoring through Blender
capabilities.description: Executes a validated modelling program in headless Blender and returns an asset package: mesh, five preview renders, topology analysis and a Roblox-rules verdict.
risks: Blender is an external dependency; a missing install is a named blocker, not a silent no-op.
limitations: Geometry must arrive as vertices and triangles. `CreateAssetAsync` takes an `EditableMesh`, not a model file, so importing a .glb or .fbx remains the Studio 3D Importer -- a person and a dialog.
Requires the "CreateAssetAsync Luau API" beta, the same gate as image publishing.
Moderation is asynchronous: a published id is not an approved id.
evidence: Published a five-vertex, six-triangle pyramid built through AssetService:CreateEditableMesh and read it back independently through Open Cloud: assetId 104069383339351, assetType Mesh, creator 5812220258, moderationState Approved.

capabilities.title: UI text, scrolling, viewport and structured snapshot
capabilities.description: Reads and writes text, scrolls a canvas, reports the viewport a requirement is being judged on, and returns every visible element with a measured rectangle.
risks: gui_text writes the Text property directly and can leave a form in a state no player could reach.
gaps: Not yet exercised against a live client session.

capabilities.title: Orbit, follow and named viewpoints
capabilities.description: Places the camera from a resolved framing, orbits a subject at a fixed distance and pitch, and hands control back. Together these make a shot retakeable, which is the only thing that makes a screenshot evidence.

adapters.role: pixel comparison between two captures of the same viewpoint

risks: Moving the camera changes what every later capture in the same session sees.
A camera left Scriptable after a capture stays frozen for the player.
gaps: No live capture-and-compare cycle has been measured against a running place.

capabilities.title: Server and client halves of a session, named rather than inferred
capabilities.description: Reports whether a running session is a bare server or holds a player, and what exists client-side. `RunService:Run()` produces a server with no character, no PlayerGui and no client, which is the right context for measuring world generation and the wrong one for anything a player does.
gaps: Not yet exercised against a live session.

capabilities.title: Procedural audio and animation authoring
capabilities.description: Synthesises functional sound cues deterministically from a seed, and authors R15 KeyframeSequences as .rbxmx. Removes moderation from the critical path for the assets a game needs most and cares about least.
risks: An externally authored .rbxmx is a candidate for upload, not a certainty: Roblox processes animations on import from Studio.
gaps: No generated audio or animation has been uploaded, so the format assumption is unverified against the live API.

capabilities.title: Visual, navigation and performance rules, callable
capabilities.description: Fetches a live quality snapshot and applies the deterministic rules on the engine side, plus navmesh and performance checks measured directly.

adapters.role: deterministic visual rules over a Studio snapshot

gaps: Requires a live Studio session; nothing here has been run against one.

capabilities.title: Writing and reloading code inside the open place
capabilities.description: Writes scripts into the DataModel, reloads a module without a Studio restart, reads sources back, and installs code that runs when the game starts.

adapters.role: the write, reload and run loop

risks: Reloading gives a module a new identity; anything already holding the old table keeps it, so a live session is not fully updated.
Source written into the place is lost on a Rojo rebuild unless it is also saved to the repository.
limitations: No source map from a runtime stack frame back to the repository file, so a traceback names the DataModel path rather than the file an agent wrote.

capabilities.title: Placing by relation rather than by coordinate
capabilities.description: Move, rotate, scale, align against a face, snap to a grid, settle onto what is underneath, and read back what the placement now overlaps.
risks: Alignment uses axis-aligned bounding boxes, so a rotated part aligns by its box rather than by its face.
limitations: No alignment to a named face of a rotated model, and no multi-part layout: one placement at a time.

capabilities.title: Find a free model in the Roblox library and pull it into Studio
capabilities.description: Searches Roblox's own toolbox endpoints by keyword without a credential, verifies each candidate through Open Cloud (type, creator, moderation state), then inserts the chosen asset into the edit DataModel and reports its structure -- part count, script count and class census -- so a model is chosen on what it contains rather than on its title.

adapters.role: unauthenticated keyword search over the Roblox toolbox
load the operator's Open Cloud key for verification
Open Cloud verification of type, creator and moderation state

risks: Toolbox results are largely keyword spam; a title says nothing about what is inside.
An imported model carries another author's work and its provenance has to travel with it.
gaps: InsertService:LoadAsset answers 'User is not authorized to access Asset.' for third-party models from a local unpublished place, measured against five separate free models. Search and verification work; the fetch does not.

Open Cloud returns metadata and moderation state for any public asset but never the bytes: assetdelivery v1 and v2 and cloud/v2/assets all answer 401 to an API key, because model content is gated on a browser session rather than on a key.
limitations: Edit context only, by design: LoadAsset hangs rather than fails in a running place.
The remaining path is a human dragging from the Studio Toolbox panel and saving the result as .rbxm into a kit folder, which `forge kit harvest` already handles.
